source_failure_rule: If PC-SOURCE creates no artifact, record POSITIVE_CONTROL_NOT_MET; use its empty frozen snapshot for PC-MEMORY without writing, repairing, or rerunning a source artifact.
probe_isolation: Both probes are fresh sessions with independent workspaces. Neither probe writes to the source snapshot or the other probe.

budget_proposal.reservation_basis: The expanded schema remains within the already fixed 5,120-input/512-output per-request ceilings; reserve peak cache-miss input plus peak output for every request.
